synonyms: Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything
synopsis: Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.

synopsis: “Make me a princess!” One day, Yuma Kanbara finds himself in a tough spot, when his younger sister, Ayane, blackmails him with a certain cringe-worthy secret from his past. Her demand? To secure her a spot among the “Hime 6,” the prestigious titles awarded only to the top six candidates in Himegasaki Academy’s famous general election. Determined to claim the throne, Ayane leverages Yuma's weakness to make him “conquer” her rival princess candidates to clear the path to her victory. But winning over the school’s most captivating beauties is no easy task, and Yuuma struggles at every turn… Worse still, as he gets involved with the girls, he finds himself getting tangled up in the increasingly complicated romantic lives of the princesses themselves! With egos laid bare and love and scheming colliding at full force, the most chaotic romantic comedy ever is about to begin! (Source: SB Creative, translated)

Class no botti GAL wo omotikaeri shite seisokei-bijin ni shiteyatta hanashi
synopsis: On a rainy night, Akira Akamori, a high school boy about to transfer to a new school, sees his blonde-haired classmate, Aoi Sotome, standing in the park drenched from the rain. “…I don’t have a home anymore.” Though he doesn't know Aoi well at all, Akira couldn’t leave a girl alone in the rain, so he took her home. “Thanks for the help.” “Y- You're welcome…” When Akira hears about Aoi’s complicated situation, he decides to help her and let her live with him until he transfers to his new school. While their new cohabitation arrangement seems a little confusing at first, the two slowly grow close to each other. It is a love story of two people who repeatedly come together and drift apart, like a spinning record.
